officialTrigger.description: Each rapid kill with this weapon progressively increases reload speed for a short time.

communitySource.text:
Weapon Kills grant 1 Stack of Feeding Frenzy for 3.5 seconds, increasing the Reload Speed of the weapon. Maximum of 5 Stacks.
Bonuses at 1|2|3|4|5 Stacks:
• 8|50|60|75|100 Reload Speed
• 2.5%|10%|13%|16%|20% decreased Reload Animation Duration

unknownLifecycle.reason: Not specified in the pinned base Clarity entry or official description; master must label any implementation choice local policy.

reloadFormula.ticks: ceil(seconds * 20), once after stat and scalar
reloadFormula.curveClassification: Same pinned historical W46 Oracle curve inputs used by W62

dragonflySecondaryKillFeedingFrenzyCredi.localPolicy: Master credits confirmed Dragonfly secondary weapon final blows using original paid source token; unrelated ability kills do not qualify.
dragonflySecondaryKillFeedingFrenzyCredi.boundary: Pinned exact-base Clarity entry says Weapon Kills, but does not explicitly establish Dragonfly secondary-kill proc attribution.

limitations: Manifest proves exact selected optional traits and stats, not that any stack automatically selects a trait.
Clarity is community research. Its live-branch commit is pinned; this is not a new Destiny gameplay measurement.
The exact-base Clarity entry does not establish stow persistence, reload consumption, refresh scope or expiration mode.
Absolute reload durations inherit W46 historical community approximations, not a current sandbox certification.
Reload-start snapshot and tick quantization are local integration policies.
No enhanced, newer weapon copies, armor/magazine/masterwork modifiers or unproved combined-perk formulas.
All 13 selected supported weapons use whole-magazine timing; no first-shell measurement is inferred.
